criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines deliver $272M, Alaska, the AI-directing claim, and a clean non-snarky correction signal within the ~210-char 'see more' window; stakes are concrete and the load-bearing claim is named upfront.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Correction rides on a live $272M allocation decision with named Alaska organizations (Tanana Chiefs Conference, Ryan Air, Wrangell School District), a July 2026 award date, and a hard October 30, 2026 close; both the claim and the consequence are specific and urgent.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Paragraph 3 grants the structural logic generously (no-facilities rule, compressed timeline, AI-vendor dominance in the proposal pool) without snark; the dossier's additional nuance that AI fits the no-capital-asset requirement is the only missing element.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Telehealth Broadband Project is a primary measurement source in the dossier; the advancing-proposals point traces to GovTech, a credible secondary outlet, but is not corroborated by a second independent outlet, preventing a 10.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named entities, dollar amounts, percentages, Mbps benchmarks, facility counts, dates, and agencies appear every 1-2 sentences throughout the body.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim attribution confirmed verbatim to a primary source; counter-evidence pairs a primary source (Telehealth Broadband Project) with one credible secondary (GovTech) rather than two independent outlets, limiting the ceiling.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, corrective without contempt, structurally precise; no banned phrases or LinkedIn-influencer cadence; the bullet intro 'They include the following.' is the single mildly listicle-y moment.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 441 words and 2917 chars are within rubric bounds; one bullet block with 5 single-clause items; tight 2-4 sentence paragraphs throughout.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closing question is debatable, time-anchored to this month, targets the right decision-maker, and maps directly to the corrected frame; no rhetorical softener or follow CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: A program manager finishing the post can name the specific revisit: re-sequence RHTP spend toward connectivity and logistics before AI tools, with named non-AI examples and a hard October 30, 2026 deadline.
